# shallnot

> A deterministic spec-to-test traceability gate for software written by coding agents. Requirements carry revisioned IDs (`ID~REVISION`); tests carry the tag `[verifies ID~REVISION]`; shallnot joins specs, test sources and JUnit XML results, and fails unless every requirement is cited by a test that ran and passed. Single static Go binary, no network access, no model calls. Works with pytest, Jest, Vitest, JUnit 5 (Maven, Gradle), Go and any runner that writes JUnit XML. Apache-2.0.

Install with `go install github.com/RachidChabane/shallnot/cmd/shallnot@latest` or a binary from the releases page. `shallnot init` equips a repository: config, agent instructions in `AGENTS.md`, skills, and an end-of-turn hook for Claude Code and Cursor. `shallnot gate` runs the project's tests and gives the verdict. Exit codes: 0 clean, 1 blocked, 2 no verdict.

## Docs

- [README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/RachidChabane/shallnot/main/README.md): what it is, install, first use
- [Equipping agents](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/RachidChabane/shallnot/main/docs/agents.md): `shallnot init`, end-of-turn hooks, the plugin
- [Spec format](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/RachidChabane/shallnot/main/docs/spec-format.md): the requirement model, Markdown and YAML specs
- [Binding tests](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/RachidChabane/shallnot/main/docs/binding.md): where the tag goes for each test runner
- [Configuration](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/RachidChabane/shallnot/main/docs/configuration.md): `shallnot.yaml`, flags, severities, exit codes
- [JSON report](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/RachidChabane/shallnot/main/docs/report.md): the versioned report, every field, state and finding category
- [Pipeline gate](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/RachidChabane/shallnot/main/docs/pipeline-gate.md): gating an unattended agent pipeline, focus, advisory mode, several repositories

## Agent skills

- [shallnot](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/RachidChabane/shallnot/main/plugin/skills/shallnot/SKILL.md): bind tests, run the gate, react to each finding, what never to do
- [shallnot-plan](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/RachidChabane/shallnot/main/plugin/skills/shallnot-plan/SKILL.md): write a request down as requirements before building it
- [shallnot-review](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/RachidChabane/shallnot/main/plugin/skills/shallnot-review/SKILL.md): judge whether a tagged test verifies its requirement
